description: Opens the interactive Chop it app for an explicit request such as 'open Chop it', 'load the app' or 'show my This Week screen'. view selects this_week, saved_weeks, recipes, pantry, shopping or meal_planning; recipeId opens one recipe's own screen, which is how a person looks at a recipe from a plan, a search or their week. Returns the new app shell where enabled, otherwise a normal browser link. Reads and writes no account data and creates no draft. Available without an account; private screens require sign-in.

recipeId.description: Opens this one recipe's screen. A recipeId from a plan, a search, the week or the library; view is then recipes.

name: open_chopit
title: Open Chop it
